function createOrder(uint256 amountA, uint256 priceB1e6) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 id) { require(amountA > 0 && priceB1e6 > 0, "invalid order"); id = orders.length; orders.push(Order({ maker: msg.sender, amountA: amountA, priceB1e6: priceB1e6, active: true })); uint256 balBefore = tokenA.balanceOf(address(this)); _call(address(tokenA), abi.encodeCall(IERC20.transferFrom, (msg.sender, address(this), amountA))); require(tokenA.balanceOf(address(this)) - balBefore == amountA, "unsupported token (fee on transfer)"); emit OrderCreated(id, msg.sender, amountA, priceB1e6); }
